summary: Explains items2dict (2.7+) for turning a list of key/value items into a dict, with key_name and value_name for lists using other field names; wrong names cause KeyError.
questions: How do I convert a list of key/value objects into a dictionary?
How do I build a dict from a list of objects with custom field names?
Why do I get KeyError: key from items2dict?

answer_card.title: Converting lists to dictionaries with items2dict
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ tags | items2dict }}
```

Turns `[{key: Application, value: payment}, ...]` into `{Application: payment, ...}`.

For other field names:

```jinja
{{ fruits | items2dict(key_name='fruit', value_name='color') }}
```

Missing or wrong names give `KeyError: key` (or `KeyError: <typo>`).
